title: One Dashboard. Faster Response.
description: Bring server operations into one dashboard, with visibility into services, storage, network health, and scheduled tasks. ChatGPT MCP connectors enable remote agentic management through conversation, while an integrated agent responds to new alerts by investigating logs and service health. Sensitive actions require approval, and activity and findings remain available for review.
features: Remote management through ChatGPT MCP connectors
audience: Home server administrators and professional server operators
